plugins.prepareCmd: for chart in charts/*/Chart.yaml; do sed -i 's/^version:.*/version: ${nextRelease.version}/' $chart && sed -i 's/^appVersion:.*/appVersion: "${nextRelease.version}"/' $chart; done && wget -qO /tmp/helm-docs.tar.gz https://github.com/norwoodj/helm-docs/releases/download/v1.14.2/helm-docs_1.14.2_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/helm-docs.tar.gz -C /tmp helm-docs && for dir in charts/*/; do /tmp/helm-docs --chart-search-root $dir --output-file README.md --log-level warning; done
